record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: SLAKOTH (1 star), VIGOROTH (2 stars, passive VIGOROTH) and SLAKING (3 stars, passive SLAKING) declare ABILITY SLACK_OFF with maxPP 100 and range 1. All are NORMAL/FIELD. The two passives are separate queue records; only their interaction with this ability's sleep is noted here.
record.summary: Self cleanse, self heal, then self sleep. In this order the caster (1) calls clearNegativeStatus on itself (zeroes the cooldowns of the negative statuses; flags such as wound or burn are switched off later by their update methods), (2) heals itself for maxHP x 0.3 (0.6 fallback star) through handleHeal with apBoost 1 and the cast crit, and (3) triggerSleep(3000 ms) on itself. Because the cleanse only zeroes cooldowns, a wound or burn flag set before the cast is still seen by handleHeal during the same call: a wounded caster heals 0 and a burning caster heals at half. The sleep then makes the caster unable to move or attack until it runs out, unless triggerSleep is refused: VIGOROTH has IMMUNITY_SLEEP (set by its passive on spawn), so it heals and cleanses but does not fall asleep. SLAKING enters a 3000 ms rage when its sleep ends. No target is used.

targeting.note: requiresTarget false: castable without a target in reach.

geometry.detail: No area, no movement, no board scan.

effects.resolution: Zeroes the cooldowns of burn, silence, fatigue, poison, freeze, sleep, confusion, wound, paralysis, charm, flinch, armor reduction, locked and blind; clears the curse flag but adds 2000 ms to a running curse cooldown; possession is kept when the origin is a teammate. The boolean flags (wound, burn, ...) are cleared by the update methods on a later status update, not inside this call (updateWound sets wound = false when its cooldown runs out).

declaredRaw.formula: handleHeal(maxHP x healFactor, caster, apBoost 1, crit)

effects.scaling: REQUESTED amount: maxHP x 0.3 for stars 1 to 3 (0.6 fallback). APPLIED amount in PokemonState.handleHeal: x(1 + AP/100) (apBoost 1), x critPower if the cast crit, x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 while burning, x0.5 while enraged, x1.2 under ZENITH weather, then rounded and capped at missing HP (healReceived); the rest is overheal.
effects.resolution: Nothing is healed (healReceived 0, overheal 0) when the caster's wound flag is true (a Blood Stone under BLOODMOON adds a shield instead), when its hp is 0, or when it is protected. The self cleanse runs first but only zeroes woundCooldown/burnCooldown; the wound and burn flags stay true until the update methods run, so a wounded or burning caster is still treated as wounded/burning inside this call. healDone is increased by healReceived. If overheal is above 0 and the caster has the GRASS synergy effect, 0.4 x overheal is added to max HP.

effects.scaling: REQUESTED duration: fixed 3000 ms, no AP or crit scaling. APPLIED: x1.3 under NIGHT weather, x0.7 under ZENITH, halved when enraged, then applyStatusDurationReductions (Swift Swim x0.7, Hydration x0.5, Water Veil/Surge Surfer x0.3, Odd Keystone -10% each; body read in the SING candidate, not repeated here), rounded.
effects.resolution: triggerSleep is refused when the caster is already asleep, has Rune Protect, is skydiving, has IMMUNITY_SLEEP, or has ccCooldown above 0. VIGOROTH gets IMMUNITY_SLEEP in its passive spawn effect, so for VIGOROTH the sleep is normally refused. When it applies: sleep = true and sleepCooldown = rounded duration; the unit cannot move or attack while asleep; each damage instance received shortens the remaining sleep by 300 ms; at the end ccCooldown is raised to at least CC_COOLDOWN and a SLAKING caster triggers rage for 3000 ms. The cleanse zeroed sleepCooldown first, so it does not extend an existing sleep.

statusEffects.duration: cooldowns zeroed; flags clear on the next update; curse cooldown extended by 2000 ms

starBehavior.note: The caster's stars index the heal fraction (0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.6 fallback). The sleep duration does not depend on stars. Catalog units here are 1 (SLAKOTH), 2 (VIGOROTH) and 3 (SLAKING) stars, so every catalog caster heals 30% of max HP (requested).

record.positionalConditions: None; self-only and no range or target needed.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state in the strategy. While asleep the unit cannot act, so a second cast needs the sleep to end (or never begin, as for VIGOROTH). After waking, ccCooldown blocks a new sleep for at least 1500 ms.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested heal: 30% of maxHP (60% fallback). Applied: x(1 + AP/100) x critPower if crit, x1.3 / x0.5 burning / x0.5 enraged / x1.2 ZENITH, rounded, capped at missing HP, and 0 when the wound flag is set at cast time (the cleanse does not remove the flag in time). Requested sleep: 3000 ms; applied after weather, rage and reductions, or refused (already asleep, Rune Protect, skydiving, IMMUNITY_SLEEP, ccCooldown).
